title: Prometheus text file

fields.name: alias
fields.description: Sets an alias. Use for multiple instances of the same input plugin. If no alias is specified, a default name is assigned using the plugin name followed by a dot and a sequence number.

fields.name: log_level
fields.description: Specifies the log level for input plugin. If not set here, plugin uses global log level in service section.

fields.name: log_suppress_interval
fields.description: Suppresses log messages from input plugin that appear similar within a specified time interval. 0 no suppression.

fields.name: mem_buf_limit
fields.description: Set a memory buffer limit for the input plugin. If the limit is reached, the plugin will pause until the buffer is drained. The value is in bytes. If set to 0, the buffer limit is disabled.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Comma-separated list of files or glob patterns to read. Supports * wildcard (for example, /var/lib/prometheus/*.prom).

fields.name: routable
fields.description: If set to true, the data generated by the plugin will be routable, meaning that it can be forwarded to other plugins or outputs. If set to false, the data will be discarded.

fields.name: storage.pause_on_chunks_overlimit
fields.description: Enable pausing on an input when they reach their chunks limit.

fields.name: storage.type
fields.description: Sets the storage type for this input, one of: filesystem, memory or memrb.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Set a tag for the events generated by this input plugin.

fields.name: thread.ring_buffer.capacity
fields.description: Set custom ring buffer capacity when the input runs in threaded mode.

fields.name: thread.ring_buffer.window
fields.description: Set custom ring buffer window percentage for threaded inputs.

description: Fluent Bit input plugin: Prometheus text file.
